verdict.rationale: The evidence suggests server rendering through SvelteKit. It is described as the Svelte equivalent of Next/Nuxt and offers multiple rendering modes (prerendering, CSR-only SPAs), and a community member notes clarity about what loads on the server versus the client. However, server-side rendering itself is only implied, and streaming is never mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit SSR documentation, any evidence of streaming responses or streamed data and promises, evidence of faster time-to-interactive, and independent hands-on corroboration.
